info.title: The Great Sage Riddle's Time Reversal
info.synopsis: Riddle era un uomo dotato di straordinaria saggezza e potere, tanto da venir chiamato il Grande Saggio. La sua vita tuttavia viene stravolta quando una misteriosa organizzazione conosciuta come la "Box of Malice" distrugge il mondo di cui faceva parte e uccide tutti i suoi amici. Sconfitto e privo di speranza, Riddle trascorre mille anni nella sofferenza… finché trova un modo per viaggiare indietro nel tempo. Determinato a non lasciare che quel tragico destino si ripeta, Riddle usa tutta la conoscenza e l’esperienza accumulate nel corso di secoli per tornare nel passato, nel momento in cui tutto era ancora da salvare. Con il suo immenso sapere e la forza di volontà di un vero saggio, intraprende una nuova battaglia contro la minaccia oscura, deciso a cambiare il corso del futuro e proteggere il mondo che aveva perso.

episodes.title: The Day the World Shattered
episodes.synopsis: Having lost everything to the "Box of Malice"—those who plot the destruction of the world—Ryddel is pushed to the brink of despair. Refusing to give up, he spends a thousand years becoming a Great Sage and finally succeeds in reversing time using his accumulated knowledge and experience.

episodes.title: Back to the Past, The First Adventure
episodes.synopsis: Successfully leaping one thousand years back in time, Ryddel is reunited with Dalsan and Norn, the irreplaceable companions he once lost. Despite his clouded memories immediately following the time-leap, he carries out his quests as an apprentice adventurer.

episodes.title: The Apprentice With a Thousand Years of Experience
episodes.synopsis: Ryddel and his companions find themselves cornered by a massive goblin outbreak. Though his body has been rejuvenated, the mana he accumulated over a thousand years is entirely gone. Bewildered by an unprecedented level of weakening, he nevertheless stands his ground, using his knowledge and experience as weapons.

episodes.title: Ryddel's Resolve
episodes.synopsis: Defeating the King Goblin in a single blow, Ryddel delivers a flawless performance without letting a single remnant escape. His companions cannot hide their bewilderment at Ryddel's transformation , who was supposed to barely be able to use magic. Clan Leader Rayphon harbors doubts about how Riddle and his team accomplished the quest and launches an investigation.
